blocks.raw: <Tip>Memorize k-value hierarchy: polyiso (0.020) < XPS (0.025) < fiberglass (0.040) < mineral wool (0.045). R = thickness / k. In tropical climates, reflective barriers outperform bulk insulation for heat reduction. STC = sound isolation, NRC = sound absorption.</Tip>

props.mistake: Confusing R-value with k-value: thinking R-value is material-specific (it is not; R depends on thickness and k-value).
props.correction: k-value is material property (independent of thickness). R-value = thickness / k-value (depends on thickness). Thicker insulation yields higher R.
